arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout. The cron drift issue was caused by a time zone discrepancy. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, with 1388 failed jobs and 47 malformed rows. The postmortem will include a pg_dump export of the failed_jobs table.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate and resolve the reasons for the failed jobs, clean up the backlog, and implement a monitoring solution to prevent this from happening in the future.
